parsed.answer: Sorry about the delay! Under our policy, a late Standard shipment normally gets a 25% credit of the shipping fee. However, delays caused by severe weather aren't eligible for credit. Since your delay was due to the snowstorm, I'm afraid no credit applies. If you think the delay had another cause, tell me which parcel it was and I'll take a look.
